The 1-char edit is INVISIBLE to the address and LOUD to the encoder. High diffusion makes a good ADDRESS and disqualifies it as a REPRESENTATION — same axis, opposite requirement. This is why the regimes are separate ops.
XOR-by-constant is a Hamming isometry, so the frame CANNOT change a pairwise statistic. Carried for legibility and attestation only — stated, not hidden.

A coupling is consumed by quad_turn as a uniform XOR, and XOR-by-constant is an isometry — so it CANNOT carry structure into stored content whatever vector sits in the slot. What must be short is the DESCRIPTION (three integers), not the vector.
